market.question: Will Trump agree to Iranian oil sanction relief by May 31?

assessment.reasoning: Treasury already authorized the purchase of ~140M barrels of stranded Iranian oil in March 2026, an explicit waiver of sanctions on oil exports — arguably resolves Yes already. An active MOU framework being negotiated explicitly includes lifting sanctions in exchange for nuclear concessions, with Trump optimistic. However the question may require a definitive deal-driven sanctions agreement, not just a temporary tactical waiver — interpretation risk.
data_sources: cbsnews.com Trump admin temporarily lifts sanctions Iranian oil at sea
assessment.key_uncertainty: How resolution will treat existing temporary waivers vs. requiring a comprehensive nuclear deal.
